HORIZONS · Arabic · Level 1

Free demo — getting started

Free demo

Only these five letter lessons are included: Baa ب, Zhaa ظ, Daad ض, Yaa ي and Dhaal ذ. Each lesson includes words, sentences, two illustrated stories and writing practice.

The interface, operating instructions and covers are available in 32 languages. Arabic lesson text and recordings remain in Arabic. Optional meaning translations are available in English, Turkish, French and Spanish.

Operating instructions

  1. Extract the complete ZIP, then open index.html in a current browser. Keep its folders together. No activation or installation of Python is required.
  2. Choose an interface language, select a letter, then explore words, listening activities, stories and writing. Use a teacher or parent for guidance.
  3. Choose a letter form. Watch the pen demonstration, trace the model, or draw your own strokes. Undo removes the previous stroke and Clear erases the current drawing.

Export progress · Restore progress

Progress is saved only in this browser and may be lost if its data is cleared. Export a copy to keep it or restore it on another device.

The demo contains five lessons only. To obtain the full 28-letter workbook, visit the HORIZONS Gumroad store.

Privacy

This demo has no licence activation and no update service. It does not ask for an email, child data or an account. Learning progress remains in the browser.
